title: Verify that valid answers survive the citation check.
comment:
**Verify that valid answers survive the citation check.**

`store.search(question)` returns only its default lexical results. If `extract.answer` selects a semantic hit or a hit outside that result set, this check returns 409 even when the cited passage still exists. Inspect `extract.answer` and test a citation outside the lexical results. If that path is supported, validate each citation by its stored identity instead of repeating a ranked search.

title: Verify the text policy on observation imports.
comment:
**Verify the text policy on observation imports.**

If `ScreenReader.read` and `extract_notes` do not apply `NotePolicy.decode`, `import_observation` can persist a selected quote from text containing `neurobrain: do-not-store` or a credential. Unlike `import_note`, this method does not check the text at its persistence boundary. Inspect both upstream functions and test an observation containing a blocked directive. If neither function enforces the policy, validate the full text before extraction and saving.
